decisions.reason: The concept has stayed on the market and already shows a strong quantified customer saving, so the option looks valuable and cheap to keep open.
It remained on its own page across two years, which suggests enough continuing promise to preserve the option, even if market proof is still limited.
A named customer case and quantified savings reduce uncertainty materially, making continued commercialization the sensible choice.
As a 2024 launch in a core shredding area, it is still early and the firm should keep the option alive while demand information develops.
This 2024 launch is still in the learning phase, but with less visible evidence than the stronger concepts its chance of withdrawal is somewhat higher even though it should be retained for now.
